basic_details.job_title: NIPER Ahmedabad Junior Research Fellow (Pharmacology and Toxicology) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Pharmacology and Toxicology, NIPER Ahmedabad (Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Govt. of India), is engaging a Junior Research Fellow under an ANRF-funded project on IVIG and immunity in offspring following stroke in pregnancy. The post is initially for 1 year with pay of 37,000/- + HRA or 30,000/- + HRA depending on the selection route. An M.Sc./M.Tech./M.Pharm./M.S. or equivalent degree in the listed life-science subjects is required. Applications are open through a Google form until 30th November, 2026.

rows.details: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER) Ahmedabad
Investigating the therapeutic relevance of IVIG for mitigating compromised immunity in offspring following stroke in pregnancy (Project No./Code ANRF/ARG/2025/004295/LS)
Initially 1 year; renewals for a maximum additional period of 2 years
Maximum 28 years as on the last date of application
Department of Pharmacology and Toxicology, NIPER-Ahmedabad

content_sections.heading: About NIPER Ahmedabad
content_sections.text: NIPER Ahmedabad is described in the notice as an institute of national importance established by an Act of Parliament, under the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Govt. of India. This engagement is for project staff in its Department of Pharmacology and Toxicology. The Principal Investigator is Dr. Pallab Bhattacharya, Professor, Department of Pharmacology and Toxicology.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M.Sc./M.Tech./M.Pharm./M.S. or equivalent degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Neuroscience, Pharmacology or allied biomedical sciences, from a UGC recognized University/Institute/Autonomous body. The marks required are 60% aggregate or an average CGPA of 6.5 on a 10-point scale for GEN. For SC/ST/PwD candidates the marks are relaxed by 5% or by a CGPA of 0.5 (on a 10-point scale). Prior research experience in animal handling and experimentation, immunology, molecular biology, flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry and other related biomedical techniques will be preferred. Maximum 28 years as on the last date of application. Relaxation is as per ANRF/Govt. of India norms for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Women candidates; the notice does not print the number of years. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is initially for a period of 1 year or availability of fund. It may be renewed for a maximum additional period of 2 years, subject to satisfactory performance each year (2 years as JRF followed by 1 year as SRF) and continuation of the project. The position is purely temporary in nature and co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIPER Ahmedabad Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The last date is 30th November, 2026, on or before which the online Google form must be filled.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the NIPER Ahmedabad JRF post?
faq.answer: An M.Sc./M.Tech./M.Pharm./M.S. or equivalent degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Neuroscience, Pharmacology or allied biomedical sciences, with 60% aggregate marks or CGPA 6.5 for GEN, from a UGC recognized University/Institute/Autonomous body.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years as on the last date of application, with relaxation as per ANRF/Govt. of India norms for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Women candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NIPER Ahmedabad JRF?
faq.answer: It is 37,000/- + HRA for scholars selected through CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or national level examinations of Central Government Departments, Agencies and Institutions. Others receive 30,000/- + HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice prints both pay figures as "+ HRA", that is 37,000/- + HRA and 30,000/- + HRA. The HRA amount is not printed.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the online Google form at https://forms.gle/H2Zhj5xr2VojzPsU6. Applying through any mode other than the Google form will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are informed by email about the further screening process / interview (Online/Offline). Original certificates must be produced at the time of the selection process.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIPER Ahmedabad JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. It is initially for 1 year or availability of fund, with renewals for a maximum additional 2 years subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
